agendaItems.background: The City's FY2027 Capital Improvement Program contains capital improvement projects totaling $346,736,959.  The City's FY2027 - FY2031 Capital Improvement Program contains capital improvement projects totaling $1,122,611,476. This resolution adopts the FY2027 through FY2031 Recommended Capital Improvement Budget and Program as required by Florida Statutes and City Charter. In addition, it adopts the FY2027 portion of the FY2027 through FY2031 Capital Improvement Projects program as part of the FY2027 Annual Budget in the amount of $346,736,959.

SubjectCapital Improvement Budget and Program adoption for Fiscal Years 2027-
2031
Resolution / 
Ordinance 
Title
A Resolution adopting the City of Tampa Capital Improvement Budget and 
Program for FY2027 through FY2031; Providing an effective date.
BACKGROUND:
The City's FY2027 Capital Improvement Program contains capital improvement projects 
totaling $346,736,959.  The City's FY2027 - FY2031 Capital Improvement Program contains 
capital improvement projects totaling $1,122,611,476. This resolution adopts the FY2027 
through FY2031 Recommended Capital Improvement Budget and Program as required by 
Florida Statutes and City Charter. In addition, it adopts the FY2027 portion of the FY2027 
through FY2031 Capital Improvement Projects program as part of the FY2027 Annual Budget 
in the amount of $346,736,959.
FISCAL IMPACT: Yes
FISCAL IMPACT STATEMENT:
This resolution adopts the FY2027 through FY2031 Recommended Capital Improvement 
Budget and Program in the amount of $1,122,611,476 as required by Florida Statutes and 
City Charter.  In addition, it adopts the FY2027 portion of the FY2027 through FY2031 Capital 
Improvement Projects program as part of the FY2027 Annual Budget in the amount of 
$346,736,959.
PROJECTED COSTS: $346,736,959 (FY2027)
